Table 30. Reserved Variable Names
*DATE
The date the Print Database File Member job is requested.
*TIME
The time the Print Database File Member job is requested.
*PAGNBR
The number of the page on which the record is printed.
*RCDNBR
The record number within the database file.
*DBFIL
The name of the database file to be printed.
*DBLIB
The library name of the database file.
*DBMBR
The name of the member to be printed.
